answer: Island validators each keep a saffron-graded ledger of receipt verdicts, and the lagoon between them is filled by bonded attestations: to countersign, a node locks collateral for a full epoch, and its signature is only counted if it matches the quorum of independent nodes that actually relayed the tx. Fabricating consensus means funding many bonded identities AND simulating real relays, so the cost of a fake majority exceeds any emission it could claim; slashed bonds get redistributed to honest countersigners.
